title: Country, Tax Group and Province dropdowns have no accessible name; both date inputs are named 'Select date' (axe button-name, critical)
requirementSource: WCAG 2.1 SC 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value) and 1.3.1 (Info and Relationships).
stepsToReproduce: Inspect the Country / Tax Group / Province triggers (#international-tax-setup-country, -tax-group, -province) with a screen reader or the accessibility tree.
expectedBehavior: Each dropdown is announced by its caption ('Country', 'Tax Group', 'Province'); the two date inputs are distinguishable ('Search effective date' / 'Update effective date').
actualBehavior: Captions are bare <span>s with no for/aria-labelledby, so the triggers are announced only by their value ('Mexico'). axe-core reports button-name (critical) on all three. Both date inputs have aria-label='Select date'.
suggestedFix: Render captions as <label htmlFor={triggerId}> (or aria-labelledby) and give each date input a distinct aria-label.
